chapter: Bennie Moten, Basie and the Reno
title: Moten's pay and work in Kansas City
summary: Moten got the best big-band jobs and paid well, with scale then about $6 a night.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Yes. Now, as I can remember it, Benny began to just grab up most of the work in Kansas City, you know, most of the big band work. At this time --
Steady gigs and what have you. He went on the best jobs.
For the time, for the period?
He was a good man to work for?
Yeah. He made good money and he was good to his men.
Yeah. Well, scale as we knew it then. It didn't have to be very much to be over scale because I think the scale at the tops was about $6.00 a night.
